title: ジャパンダートダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Japan Dirt Derby, the race that'll determine the classic year dirt champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One is impressed and fired up by how capable and ready the runners of Oi look. She then throws herself onto the festival stage.
